claim_text: At temperature 1.5 on the paper's AlpacaEval Creative Writing setup, min-p=0.1 achieved a 56.54% win rate versus 53.18% for temperature-only sampling.

source.title: Turning Up the Heat: Min-p Sampling for Creative and Coherent LLM Outputs
source.locator: Creative-writing comparison table: temperature-only and min-p at tau=1.5

supports: Min-p is a strong sampler candidate for preserving creative-writing quality at elevated temperature in this benchmark.
FrontierOS should test min-p in a model- and domain-specific sampling grid.
does_not_support: Min-p is the unique optimal sampler for all models or creative domains.
The effect is a 6.6 percentage-point improvement.
The reported win rate is equivalent to expert human blind review.

engineering_decision.action: Include min-p=0.05/0.1/0.2 in Inference Lab grids and compare on hidden domain tasks.

notes: The absolute and relative effects are derived from the two reported win rates and are intentionally stored separately.
